scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.start: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm --prefix server start" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.install-all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
